text: Electrochemical measurements were used to analyze the copper plating inhibition ability of five coumarin-based quaternary ammonium salts, leveler C2 with double coumarin structure had the strongest inhibition performance. Quantum chemical calculation and MD simulation show that leveler C2 has the strongest adsorption capacity and the most adsorption sites on copper surface, which is the reason why C2 has the strongest inhibition ability.
